_meta: 한국어 회화 음성 — 목소리·감정·자리 채움. 일본어앱 data/tts/voices.json 과 같은 짜임. 참고 음성은 VoxCPM2(설명 instruct 는 영어), 문장은 MOSS-TTS.
base_text: 오늘은 오후에 회의가 있어서 자료를 미리 준비해 두려고요. 끝나면 같이 저녁 먹으러 갈래요?

am.desc: A young Korean man in his twenties, clear and gentle voice

af.desc: A young Korean woman in her twenties, clear and soft voice

seoa.desc: A Korean woman in her early twenties, bright, quick and lively voice

minjun.desc: A Korean man in his mid twenties, relaxed and slightly deep voice

yujin.desc: A Korean woman in her twenties, calm, warm and slightly low voice

haneul.desc: A Korean woman in her early twenties, soft, sweet and cheerful voice

taeo.desc: A Korean man in his early twenties, energetic and light voice

doyun.desc: A Korean man in his late twenties, steady and friendly voice

haesol.desc: A Korean woman in her twenties, playful and clear voice

jiho.desc: A Korean man in his late twenties, dry, cool and slightly tired voice

timjang.desc: A Korean man in his late forties, deep, firm and warm voice

daeri.desc: A Korean woman in her early thirties, quick, bright and friendly voice

jian.desc: A Korean woman in her twenties, gentle and thoughtful voice

man_y.desc: A Korean man around twenty, natural and clear voice

man_m.desc: A Korean man in his forties, steady and calm voice

man_o.desc: A Korean man in his seventies, aged and gentle voice

woman_y.desc: A Korean woman around twenty, natural and clear voice

woman_m.desc: A Korean woman in her forties, composed and kind voice

woman_o.desc: A Korean woman in her seventies, aged and warm voice

kid.desc: A Korean child around eight years old, small and bright voice

mom.desc: A Korean woman in her early fifties, warm, brisk and motherly voice

grandma.desc: A Korean woman in her seventies, aged, slow and affectionate voice

prof.desc: A Korean man in his late fifties, calm, measured and slightly dry voice

announce.desc: A clear, even female announcer voice, like a subway or store announcement

robot.desc: A flat synthetic machine voice, like a kiosk or payment terminal

teen.desc: A Korean teenage girl around fifteen, quick and bright voice

neutral.ref: 오늘은 오후에 회의가 있어서 자료를 미리 준비해 두려고요.

polite.instruct: polite and professional, like a clerk or station staff
polite.ref: 안녕하세요, 고객님. 주문하신 메뉴 나왔습니다. 맛있게 드세요.

stiff.instruct: very nervous and stiff, formal and overly polite
stiff.ref: 오늘 시간 내 주셔서 정말 감사합니다. 열심히 하겠습니다. 잘 부탁드립니다.

cheerful.ref: 오, 왔어? 잘 왔어. 오늘 날씨도 좋고, 완전 기분 좋다.

amused.ref: 하하, 진짜 웃긴다. 좋아, 그 느낌 그대로 가자.

teasing.ref: 뭐야, 그 표정은. 자, 솔직히 말해 봐. 아무한테도 말 안 할게.

excited.instruct: excited, bursting with energy, bright and loud
excited.ref: 됐다, 말했어! 나도 깜짝 놀랐어. 진짜 고마워요!

surprised.instruct: surprised, caught off guard, voice jumps
surprised.ref: 어? 진짜요? 아니, 잠깐만요. 그게 무슨 말이에요?

shout.instruct: surprised and loud, an exaggerated comic retort
shout.ref: 뭐라고요? 지금요? 아니, 갑자기 그러면 어떡해요!

tsukkomi.instruct: a quick sharp comic retort, exasperated but fond
tsukkomi.ref: 아니, 그게 아니라! 거기서 왜 그러세요, 진짜.

annoyed.ref: 아, 진짜. 또 그 얘기예요? 그만 좀 하세요.

sad.ref: 그냥… 좀 힘들었어요. 괜찮아요. 신경 쓰지 마세요.

worried.ref: 괜찮아요? 어디 아픈 거 아니에요? 병원 가 봐야 하는 거 아니에요?

flustered.ref: 어, 저, 그게, 잠깐만요… 뭐라고 해야 할지 모르겠어요…

shy.ref: 아… 그게… 저도 좋아요. 그러니까… 같이 가요.

gentle.ref: 괜찮아. 천천히 해도 돼. 내가 옆에 있을게.

_cast_note: plan_from_dialogue.py 가 speakers 이름 → 목소리 자동 배정에 쓰는 표. 없는 이름은 '아주머니/할머니/엄마/언니/누나/여' 가 들어가면 woman_m, '아저씨/할아버지/아빠/형/오빠' 는 man_m, 그 밖은 man_y/woman_y 를 번갈아.
